title: [PM-39190] [PM-19354] fix(generator): restore catch-all website-name option
body: ## 🎟️ Tracking Fixes https://github.com/bitwarden/clients/issues/13899 [Bitwarden internal tracking](https://bitwarden.atlassian.net/browse/PM-39190) ## 📔 Objective This PR restores the missing **Website name** option for catch-all email username generation in the new generator UI. ## 📸 Screenshots

comments.body:
[![CLA assistant check](https://cla-assistant.io/pull/badge/signed)](https://cla-assistant.io/bitwarden/clients?pullRequest=21338)
All committers have signed the CLA.

Thank you for your contribution! We've added this to our internal tracking system for review.
ID: PM-39190
Link: https://bitwarden.atlassian.net/browse/PM-39190

Details on our contribution process can be found here: https://contributing.bitwarden.com/contributing/pull-requests/community-pr-process.

Thanks @esteve for taking initiative to resolve this. The first step in our [community PR review process](https://contributing.bitwarden.com/contributing/pull-requests/community-pr-process/#product-assessment) is assessment by our internal product team. I've also messaged the team directly because I think it's important to restore this functionality, provided it aligns with any future work they may have planned for generator functionality. 

I'll reach out to you here when I have any updates. Thanks again for your contribution.

~~@esteve One thing I notice when comparing the proposed changes against our current production extension is that no "Generator History" is shown. Additionally, it looks like the selector component at top of the extension view has been replaced with some sort of navigable view. I expect our product team to ask about these changes, and if the restored functionality might be able to be better integrated into our current design. I've attached a comparison below to better explain the changes I am seeing.~~

@harr1424 thanks for the feedback. However, this is what I see on the Firefox extension without my changes, it looks quite different from yours, it doesn't have the generator history nor the lower section:
This is the version of the extension I'm using, I downloaded it from addons.mozilla.org

My apologies @esteve as I made an assumption you were using the Generator tab to demonstrate this. When attempting to generate a username from within a vault item, I do see the same design you are showing.

@harr1424: I think @esteve is showing the inline username generator from within a login item.

I remember that during the migration of the forwarders into the newer generator framework the website option got removed. 

[PM-16948](https://bitwarden.atlassian.net/browse/PM-16948) and the parent epic + child-tickets have more information relating to website on plus-address and catch-all.



[PM-16948]: https://bitwarden.atlassian.net/browse/PM-16948?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ

Hi @esteve thanks for your patience regarding this PR. The team has received approval from our internal product teams to move forward with this change, with one adjustment requested: 

Would you be willing to adjust the radio buttons such that they are stacked vertically, by making use of [this component](https://components.bitwarden.com/?path=/docs/component-library-form-radio-button--docs#block)?
@harr1424 sure! I've pushed https://github.com/bitwarden/clients/pull/21338/commits/eda4fba44a1229c452c1fdcace580f6491f2374e with that change, let me know if that's all. Thanks.
@harr1424 I've just rebased this PR on top of main so that there's no need to merge from main and to keep the history clean.
